text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I bid you good morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm ever so grateful for the time off you granted me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I mended my dolls' clothing and enjoyed a carefree day on my terms.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But now it's time to flip my mood switch and go zoooom! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It sounds like Mejiro Bright made the most of her time off.
